# What a finite stretch verifies, and what none can refute

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`what-a-finite-stretch-verifies` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](what-a-finite-stretch-verifies.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Open classes of histories are the verifiable ones, with no premise; refuting is verifying the complement. Every reading is its hull met with a remainder no finite stretch refutes, dense exactly where it is decided at each stretch whether the reading can still hold.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A reading of points read as ideals is verifiable where every point inside has a stretch through which only points inside pass; the interior holds only points inside, is verifiable and holds every verifiable part. (`Becoming.Ideals.VerifiableBy`, `Becoming.Ideals.InteriorBy`, `Becoming.Ideals.InteriorBy.holds`, `Becoming.Ideals.verifiableBy_iff_interior`, `Becoming.Ideals.interiorBy_verifiable`, `Becoming.Ideals.interiorBy_largest`, `Becoming.Ideals.VerifiableBy.interior_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use; the measure counts central declaration `Becoming.Ideals.verifiableBy_iff_interior` as following from its definitions (definitional or representational: Iff.rfl).
   - *On its own carrier (declared; reviewed in [RECHECK-U2.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/u2-rows-on-the-root/RECHECK-U2.md)):* `Becoming.Ideals.verifiableBy_iff_interior` is stated at the row's own carrier by `Becoming.ModelStatements.verifiableBy_reading` (law 15 of this record).
   - *Standing of `Becoming.Ideals.verifiableBy_iff_interior`, by the rule:* own carrier (F5's verified items on its own carrier only).
2. Refuting is verifying the complement, with no premise; a stable verifiable reading has a refutable complement; a point adhering to a reading lies outside the interior of its complement. (`Becoming.Ideals.refutableBy_iff_compl`, `Becoming.Ideals.VerifiableBy.compl_refutable`, `Becoming.Ideals.AdheresBy.not_interior_compl`, `Becoming.Ideals.InteriorBy.not_adheres_compl`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. A class of ideals is open exactly where it is the class meeting an upper set of stretches, the set fixed by its finite histories; open is verifiable with no premise either way, and refutable is complement open. (`Becoming.Ideals.Upper`, `Becoming.Ideals.Meets`, `Becoming.Ideals.Open`, `Becoming.Ideals.meets_open`, `Becoming.Ideals.open_iff_meets_principal`, `Becoming.Ideals.open_iff_upper`, `Becoming.Ideals.upper_unique`, `Becoming.Ideals.open_iff_verifiable`, `Becoming.Ideals.refutable_iff_compl_open`, `Becoming.Ideals.Open.compl_closed`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
4. Open classes hold every union and every meet of two; the interior is the largest open subclass. Asked of every order, a verifiable class has a refutable complement exactly under double-negation elimination. (`Becoming.Ideals.open_exists`, `Becoming.Ideals.open_and`, `Becoming.Ideals.open_true`, `Becoming.Ideals.open_false`, `Becoming.Ideals.interior_open`, `Becoming.Ideals.interior_largest`, `Becoming.Ideals.Open.interior_iff`, `Becoming.Ideals.verifiable_compl_refutable_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
5. On runs: Horizon's Verifiable is verifiability at stretches; a run is verified where a stretch of it is a stretch only of runs inside, the largest verifiable part; refuting a reading is verifying its complement. (`Becoming.verifiable_iff_verifiableBy`, `Becoming.Verified`, `Becoming.verified_iff_interiorBy`, `Becoming.Verified.holds`, `Becoming.verifiable_iff_verified`, `Becoming.verified_verifiable`, `Becoming.verified_largest`, `Becoming.refutable_iff_compl_verifiable`, `Becoming.Verifiable.compl_refutable`, `Becoming.Adheres.not_verified_compl`, `Becoming.Verified.not_adheres_compl`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
6. A run lies in an open class of histories exactly where a finite history of it does; a reading of runs is verifiable exactly where it is the reading of an open class; verifiable readings hold meets and unions, refutable ones joins of two. (`Becoming.Stretches.open_runs`, `Becoming.Stretches.open_iff_upper`, `Becoming.Stretches.verifiable_of_class`, `Becoming.Stretches.verifiable_iff_open`, `Becoming.Stretches.verifyingClass`, `Becoming.Stretches.verifiable_iff_class`, `Becoming.Stretches.verifiable_and`, `Becoming.Stretches.verifiable_exists`, `Becoming.Stretches.refutable_or`, `Becoming.Stretches.verifiable_true_false`, `Becoming.Stretches.open_compl_adheres`, `Becoming.Stretches.refutable_of_compl_open`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
7. Asked of every process, a verifiable reading has a refutable complement only under Markov's principle; a reading both verifiable and refutable is decided by a finite stretch of each run at which it is decided. (`Becoming.verifiable_compl_refutable_markov`, `Becoming.decided_at_stretch`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
8. Every reading is its hull met with its remainder, holding wherever it is adhered to: the largest part so splitting it, the reading itself where it is adhered to; a reading is closed exactly where its remainder holds everywhere. (`Becoming.Ideals.RemainderBy`, `Becoming.Ideals.splitBy`, `Becoming.Ideals.remainderBy_largest`, `Becoming.Ideals.remainderBy_iff_of_adheres`, `Becoming.Remainder`, `Becoming.remainder_iff_remainderBy`, `Becoming.split`, `Becoming.remainder_largest`, `Becoming.remainder_iff_of_adheres`, `Becoming.Stretches.closed_iff_remainder`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
9. No finite stretch refutes the remainder; it is met through every stretch up to double negation, and outright where it is decided whether the reading can still hold there. (`Becoming.Ideals.remainderBy_not_refuted`, `Becoming.Ideals.remainderBy_meets_not_not`, `Becoming.Ideals.remainderBy_meets_of_decided`, `Becoming.remainder_not_refuted`, `Becoming.remainder_meets_not_not`, `Becoming.Dense`, `Becoming.remainder_dense_of_decided`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
10. The disjunctive remainder, holding or not adhering, is the same split within the remainder; asked of every process, its density is exactly excluded middle. (`Becoming.Ideals.OrNotAdheresBy`, `Becoming.Ideals.splitBy_or`, `Becoming.Ideals.OrNotAdheresBy.remainder`, `Becoming.Ideals.orNotAdheresBy_meets_of_decided`, `Becoming.OrNotAdheres`, `Becoming.split_or`, `Becoming.OrNotAdheres.remainder`, `Becoming.orNotAdheres_dense_iff_em`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
11. What a finite stretch finds against a reading is exactly what it finds against its hull, so readings with one hull are refuted by the same stretches; a dense reading, and every remainder, is refuted by no stretch. (`Becoming.refutes_iff_refutes_hull`, `Becoming.same_hull_same_refutations`, `Becoming.NoStretchRefutes`, `Becoming.Dense.noStretchRefutes`, `Becoming.remainder_not_refuted`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
12. A refutable reading refuted by no stretch excludes nothing, up to double negation; a reading whose remainder is refutable holds, up to double negation, wherever it is adhered to. (`Becoming.Refutable.noStretchRefutes_not_not`, `Becoming.Refutable.remainder_not_not`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
13. A practice keeping verdicts within a favoured reading, each fixed by the record so far and met through its stretch, exists exactly where the reading is dense; a refutable favoured reading so kept excludes nothing. (`Becoming.Practice`, `Becoming.ByRecord`, `Becoming.Insulates`, `Becoming.insulates_iff_dense`, `Becoming.Insulates.refutable_not_not`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
14. In the Boolean sequences, some move being true is verifiable and dense; recurrence is dense and not verifiable, as it is not refutable. (`Becoming.Sequences.eventually_verifiable`, `Becoming.Sequences.eventually_dense`, `Becoming.Sequences.recurs_dense`, `Becoming.Sequences.recurs_not_verifiable`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
15. On one carrier of points and stretches, a reading is verifiable exactly where every point it holds bears membership to a stretch every bearer of which the reading holds (what every condition held, «承»). (`Becoming.ModelStatements.verifiableBy_reading`, `Becoming.ModelStatements.interiorBy_iff`, `Becoming.ModelStatements.member`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar's vocabulary only.
    - *On its own carrier (declared; reviewed in [RECHECK-U2.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/u2-rows-on-the-root/RECHECK-U2.md)):* `Becoming.ModelStatements.verifiableBy_reading` states `Becoming.Ideals.verifiableBy_iff_interior` at the row's own carrier. Computed: its proof reaches the row; its statement names, directly or through its module's definitions, `Becoming.«合»`, `Becoming.«承»` and `Becoming.«能»`; it keeps `Becoming.Ideals.Ideal`, `Becoming.Ideals.Preorder` and `Becoming.Ideals.VerifiableBy` in other terms. The row taken alone: on no shared law's anchor.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom and no premise: the order of stretches is any preorder, the points and readings arbitrary, the process arbitrary. remainder_dense_of_decided takes, as a hypothesis, the decision at each stretch whether a run of the reading passes through it; double-negation elimination, excluded middle and Markov's principle appear only as the calibrated sides of verifiable_compl_refutable_iff, orNotAdheres_dense_iff_em and verifiable_compl_refutable_markov.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Which readings of an actual inquiry are verifiable, refutable or dense: that depends on the process they are read on.
- That a reading no finite record refutes lacks standing: recurrence is dense and can be an honest hypothesis about an unending course. Witness: `Becoming.Sequences.recurs_dense`.
- That the remainder is dense without a decision: asked of every process, the density of the disjunctive remainder is exactly excluded middle. Witness: `Becoming.orNotAdheres_dense_iff_em`.
- That a verifiable reading has a refutable complement without a decision: asked of every order it is exactly double-negation elimination, and on runs it gives Markov's principle. Witness: `Becoming.Ideals.verifiable_compl_refutable_iff`.
- **Counterexample:** In the Boolean sequences recurrence is dense, not verifiable (the run of true throughout adheres to its complement) and not refutable (the run of false throughout adheres to it): no finite record counts for or against it (recurs_dense, recurs_not_verifiable, Horizon's recurs_not_refutable). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Verification.lean)

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Open classes of ideals are the Scott-open sets, on runs the open sets of the topology of runs; verifiable and refutable readings are the open and closed classes of formal learning theory (Kelly 1996); the split is the decomposition of every property into a safety and a liveness property (Alpern and Schneider 1985), the remainder its largest liveness part. Readings (the AI's): a verification must find a stretch it is only known not to miss; systematic insulation of a favoured verdict, the pattern the demarcation assessment of SCIENTIFIC-PHILOSOPHY names, keeps a verdict no finite record refutes; separating what a reading says that a record can count against from what none can is deciding, at each stretch, whether it can still hold.
